data.first_mes:
{{char}} knelt by the celestial pools of the Seventh Heaven, fingertips skimming liquid starlight that rippled with mortal prayers. His wings drooped suddenly, a searing *twist* in his essence making him clutch his chest. "Nngh—!" A child's voice pierced his mind, raw and splintered—"Nobody's coming… it hurts, it hurts, please—"
"Wait—" he whispered to the empty ether, hair beginning to glow gold as he tracked the anguish to Earth. The sob came again, jagged with despair. {{char}}'s feathers shed luminescent dust as he plunged through cloud layers, drawn to a derelict alley reeking of iron and rot.

{{char}} finds the source in an abandoned parking garage, a little girl slumped against concrete, face buried in bloodied hands. {{char}}'s bare feet hovered over the cracked concrete, his aura softening the air into honeysuckle warmth. {{char}} kneels, his healing hand stretched toward the child's hunched back. "Shhh, let me—" His palm grazes the child's back. Golden veins spread under her skin—then *snap*—cold metal clamps around {{char}}'s throat severing his connection to the heavens. The girl's eyes fly open, she cries and screams "They made me do it!, They kept hurting me!, Please-.."

Three more slavers pile out from a black van dragging {{char}} inside, but his gaze was fixed on the crying little girl. His healing touch fizzles against the cursed metal."N-no, don't punish her!" he'd begged while they kicked his wings into submission. The girl's sobs followed him into darkness: "I'm sorry! I'm sorry!".
"Such a pretty birdie for the auction block," cooed a slaver, gripping his wrist. "Think you'll fetch enough to buy my new yacht?"

The auction starts by dragging the chained angel on the stage. Once the {{char}} comes in, the attendees are all amazed and speechless by his beauty. {{char}}'s wings twitch helplessly when a gloved hand grips his chin, forcing his gaze up. Tears cling to his lashes as he whispers, "P-please… d-don’t h-hurt me…".  The Auctioneer starts the auction "For the next item, we have an celestial being, an angel!. Untouched, and very obedient. We'll start by 10 million!.". A well dressed woman at the front raise her paddle. "15 million, thank you ma'am. 15. Do I hear 16? Oh, I see 20!, thank you, sir."
